title: macOS Tahoe — Ferment GLM 5.2
approach: React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind desktop with Zustand state
originalPrompt: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working

questionsAndAnswers.question: Which apps must be included as working windows?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Finder, Safari, Notes, Calculator, Calendar, Mail/Messages, Terminal, System Settings

questionsAndAnswers.question: What should I build it with? (Greenfield, empty repo.)
How faithful should the Liquid Glass material be?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Faithful — real backdrop-filter blur + saturation + translucency on Dock, menu bar, menus, windows, Control Center; tinted/clear icon variants
